stem.text: The graph shows the diameter of a tree trunk at different times.

stem.alt: Graph of diameter of tree trunk in arbitrary units against time of day from 00:00 to 00:00, with points J, K and L marked by arrows on the curve.

A.text: J shows the expansion of the trunk as water fills the xylem during transpiration.

B.text: K shows a reduction in diameter of the trunk as water is lost from the phloem due to translocation.

C.text: K shows a reduction in diameter of the trunk due to water held in tension in the xylem.

D.text: L shows the expansion of the trunk as the phloem tissue acts as a sink at night.
